The judge runs this first.\n\n    uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 1\n    uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2\n    uv run python scripts/check_submission.py --stage 2 --json\n\nStage 0 is the instructor's check of the template itself.\nExit code 0 means every check passed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport re\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nSECRET = re.compile(r\"(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN\\s*[:=]\\s*\\S{8,}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY)\")\nREPORT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nTRANSCRIPT = re.compile(r\"^iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_\\d{2}_[a-z]+-[a-z-]+_\\d{8}\\.md$\")\nSCREENS = [\"login\", \"dashboard\", \"content-list\", \"editor\", \"users\", \"editor-denied\"]\n\n\ndef sh(*args: str) -> str:\n    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout\n\n\nclass Checks:\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self.results: list[dict] = []\n\n    def add(self, ok: bool, name: str, detail: str, fix: str = \"\") -> None:\n        self.results.append({\"check\": name, \"ok\": bool(ok), \"detail\": detail, \"fix\": fix})\n\n    # --- checks -----------------------------------------------------------\n    def hygiene(self) -> None:\n        tracked = sh(\"git\", \"ls-files\").splitlines()\n        bad = [f for f in tracked if f.endswith((\".db\", \".env\")) or f.startswith(\".claude/state/\")]\n        self.add(not bad, \"no database or .env committed\", \", \".join(bad) or \"clean\",\n                 \"git rm --cached <file>, confirm .gitignore covers it, then rewrite history if it is old\")\n        history = sh(\"git\", \"log\", \"--all\", \"-p\", \"--\", \".\")\n        hits = sorted(set(SECRET.findall(history)))\n        self.add(not hits, \"no secrets in history\", f\"{len(hits)} match(es)\",\n                 \"rotate the key first, then ask Claude to rewrite history\")\n        self.add((ROOT / \".env.example\").exists(), \".env.example present\", \"\", \"restore it from the template\")\n\n    def docs(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        pairs = [\n            (\"notes/cms-field-notes.md\", \"field notes\"),\n            (\"CONTEXT.md\", \"glossary\"),\n            (\"notes/token-budget-plan.md\", \"token budget plan\"),\n            (\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\", \"usage ledger\"),\n            (\"docs/process/compaction-log.md\", \"compaction log\"),\n        ]\n        if stage >= 2:\n            pairs += [(\"README.md\", \"README\"), (\"scripts/seed_demo.py\", \"seed script\")]\n        for path, label in pairs:\n            self.add((ROOT / path).exists(), f\"{label} present\", path, f\"create {path}\")\n        if stage >= 2:\n            handoffs = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"handoff\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n            self.add(bool(handoffs), \"at least one handoff saved\", f\"{len(handoffs)} file(s)\",\n                     \"copy a /handoff document into docs/handoff/\")\n\n    def naming(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        reports = list((ROOT / \"docs\").glob(\"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_*.md\"))\n        if stage >= 2:\n            ok = any(REPORT.match(p.name) for p in reports)\n            self.add(ok, \"report named correctly\",\n                     \", \".join(p.name for p in reports) or \"missing\",\n                     \"iphs400_mp2-web-cms_report_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md, lowercase\")\n        transcripts = list((ROOT / \"docs\" / \"transcripts\").glob(\"*.md\"))\n        bad = [p.name for p in transcripts if not TRANSCRIPT.match(p.name)]\n        self.add(transcripts and not bad, \"transcripts present and named correctly\",\n                 f\"{len(transcripts)} file(s); bad: {bad or 'none'}\",\n                 \"iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_{NN}_{first}-{last}_{YYYYMMDD}.md\")\n\n    def readme(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        text = (ROOT / \"README.md\").read_text() if (ROOT / \"README.md\").exists() else \"\"\n        for needle, label in [(\"http\", \"live URL\"), (\"Run locally\", \"run-locally section\"),\n                              (\"Generative AI Use Statement\", \"AI Use Statement\")]:\n            self.add(needle.lower() in text.lower(), f\"README has {label}\", \"\",\n                     f\"add the {label} to README.md\")\n        placeholder = \"*(Required. Replace this section\" in text\n        self.add(not placeholder, \"AI Use Statement was rewritten\", \"\",\n                 \"replace the template placeholder with your own statement\")\n\n    def screenshots(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        if stage < 2:\n            return\n        files = {p.name.lower() for p in (ROOT / \"docs\" / \"screenshots\").glob(\"*\")}\n        missing = [f\"{s}-{w}\" for s in SCREENS for w in (1280, 390)\n                   if not any(s in n and str(w) in n for n in files)]\n        self.add(not missing, \"12 screenshots present\", \", \".join(missing) or \"all present\",\n                 \"docs/screenshots/{screen}-{1280|390}.png for each of: \" + \", \".join(SCREENS))\n\n    def git_state(self, stage: int) -> None:\n        tags = sh(\"git\", \"tag\").split()\n        want = [\"mp2-mvp\"] + ([\"mp2-final\"] if stage >= 2 else [])\n        for tag in want:\n            self.add(tag in tags, f\"tag {tag} exists\", \", \".join(tags) or \"none\",\n                     f\"git tag {tag} && git push --tags\")\n        paths = sh(\"git\", \"grep\", \"-l\", '-e', 'href=\"/', \"-e\", 'src=\"/', \"--\", \"*.html\")\n        self.add(not paths.strip(), \"no root-absolute paths in HTML\", paths.strip() or \"clean\",\n                 'use relative paths (\"style.css\"), not \"/style.css\"')\n\n    def tests(self) -> None:\n        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pytest\", \"-q\"], cwd=ROOT,\n                             capture_output=True, text=True)\n        self.add(run.returncode == 0, \"test suite passes\",\n                 run.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if run.stdout else \"\",\n                 \"fix failing tests before submitting\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--stage\", type=int, choices=[0, 1, 2], default=2)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--json\", action=\"store_true\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    c = Two rules the rubric checks:\n7\t\n8\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft or pending Post, like a\n9\t     draft Page, reaching site/ is a bug.\n10\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"asia/index.html\"), never\n11\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n12\t\"\"\"\n13\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n14\t\n15\timport hashlib\n16\timport shutil\n17\tfrom pathlib import Path\n18\t\n19\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n20\t\n21\tfrom app import models, settings\n22\tfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n23\t\n24\tCSS = \"\"\"/* Kenyon purple plus a warm gold accent; editorial travel-magazine pass, T11.\n25\t   Layout rule this pass enforces: prose always sits in a container (a tinted\n26\t   band, a panel, or a card) and every section announces itself, so no page\n27\t   ends in an unstructured white gap. */\n28\t:root {\n29\t  color-scheme: light dark;\n30\t  --purple: #5B2A86;\n31\t  --purple-dark: #3E1C5E;\n32\t  --purple-light: #F2EBFA;\n33\t  --gold: #C98A3B;\n34\t  --gold-dark: #9C6723;\n35\t  --ink: #1F1626;\n36\t  --muted: #5a5064;\n37\t  --card-border: #E4DCEC;\n38\t  --paper: #FDFBFE;\n39\t  --panel: #FFFFFF;\n40\t  --section-gap: 3.5rem;\n41\t  --topic-general: #5B2A86;\n42\t  --topic-housing: #2E7D6B;\n43\t  --topic-meals: #C9573B;\n44\t  --topic-social-life: #B0538B;\n45\t  --topic-academics: #2E6CA8;\n46\t  --topic-other: #6B6356;\n47\t  /* Region accents: one per Continent (cycles if a 7th is added), used for\n48\t     card top-accents and the interior page-header band. */\n49\t  --region-0: #C98A3B; --region-0-tint: #FBF0DF;\n50\t  --region-1: #2E7D6B; --region-1-tint: #E3F3EF;\n51\t  --region-2: #C9573B; --region-2-tint: #FBE9E4;\n52\t  --region-3: #2E6CA8; --region-3-tint: #E4EEF8;\n53\t  --region-4: #B0538B; --region-4-tint: #FAE9F3;\n54\t  --region-5: #6B6356; --region-5-tint: #F1EEE9;\n55\t}\n56\t* { box-sizing: border-box; }\n57\thtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\n58\tbody {\n59\t  font: 16px/1.65 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n60\t  margin: 0;\n61\t  padding: 0;\n62\t  min-height: 100vh;\n63\t  display: flex;\n64\t  flex-direction: column;\n65\t  color: var(--ink);\n66\t  background: var(--paper);\n67\t  overflow-x: hidden;\n68\t  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n69\t}\n70\th1, h2, h3 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; }\n71\ta { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n72\t:focus-visible {\n73\t  outline: 3px solid var(--gold);\n74\t  outline-offset: 2px;\n75\t  border-radius: 2px;\n76\t}\n77\t.wrap {\n78\t  max-width: 72rem;\n79\t  margin: 0 auto;\n80\t  padding: 0 1.25rem;\n81\t}\n82\tmain { display: block; flex: 1 0 auto; padding-bottom: var(--section-gap); }\n83\t\n84\t/* -- header / nav -------------------------------------------------- */\n85\t.site-header {\n86\t  position: sticky;\n87\t  top: 0;\n88\t  z-index: 10;\n89\t  flex-shrink: 0;\n90\t  background: rgba(91, 42, 134, 0.92);\n91\t  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n92\t  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);\n93\t  padding: 1rem 0;\n94\t  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);\n95\t}\n96\t.header-inner {\n97\t  display: flex;\n98\t  align-items: center;\n99\t  justify-content: space-between;\n100\t  flex-wrap: wrap;\n101\t  gap: 0.6rem 1.5rem;\n102\t}\n103\t.wordmark {\n104\t  color: #fff;\n105\t  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n106\t  font-weight: 600;\n107\t  font-size: 1.15rem;\n108\t  text-decoration: none;\n109\t  letter-spacing: 0.01em;\n110\t}\n111\t.site-nav {\n112\t  display: flex;\n113\t  flex-wrap: wrap;\n114\t  gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem;\n115\t}\n116\t.site-nav a {\n117\t  color: #E7D9F2;\n118\t  font-weight: 600;\n119\t  text-decoration: none;\n120\t  padding-bottom: 0.2rem;\n121\t  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;\n122\t}\n123\t.site-nav a:hover { color: #fff; }\n124\t.site-nav a.is-active { color: #fff; border-bottom-color: var(--gold); }\n125\t\n126\t/* -- breadcrumb ------------------------------------------------------ */\n127\t.breadcrumb {\n128\t  font-size: 0.95rem;\n129\t  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;\n130\t  color: var(--muted);\n131\t}\n132\t.breadcrumb a {\n133\t  color: var(--purple);\n134\t  font-weight: 500;\n135\t  text-decoration: none;\n136\t}\n137\t.breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n138\t.breadcrumb-sep { margin: 0 0.45rem; color: var(--muted); opacity: 0.7; }\n139\t.breadcrumb-current { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }\n140\t\n141\t/* -- hero (Home only) ----------------------------------------------- */\n142\t.hero {\n143\t  position: relative;\n144\t  overflow: hidden;\n145\t  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple) 0%, var(--purple-dark) 100%);\n146\t  color: #fff;\n147\t  padding: 3.5rem 0;\n148\t}\n149\t.hero::before {\n150\t  content: \"\";\n151\t  position: absolute;\n152\t  inset: 0;\n153\t  background-image:\n154\t    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 0 2px, transparent 2px 28px);\n155\t  pointer-events: none;\n156\t}\n157\t/* A single balanced column — narrower than .wrap so a short headline and\n158\t   pitch don't stretch edge-to-edge once there's no second column beside them. */\n159\t.hero-inner {\n160\t  position: relative;\n161\t  max-width: 36rem;\n162\t  margin: 0 auto;\n163\t  text-align: center;\n164\t}\n165\t.hero h1 {\n166\t  font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4.2vw, 2.85rem);\n167\t  margin: 0 0 1rem;\n168\t}\n169\t.hero-body {\n170\t  font-size: 1.1rem;\n171\t  color: #EDE3F7;\n172\t  margin: 0 auto;\n173\t}\n174\t.hero-cta {\n175\t  display: inline-block;\n176\t  margin-top: 1.6rem;\n177\t  background: var(--gold);\n178\t  color: #2A1240;\n179\t  font-weight: 600;\n180\t  text-decoration: none;\n181\t  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;\n182\t  border-radius: 999px;\n183\t  transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;\n184\t}\n185\t.hero-cta:hover { background: #E0A861; transform: translateY(-1px); }\n186\t\n187\t/* -- interior page-header band --------------------------------------- */\n188\t.page-header {\n189\t  background: var(--purple-light);\n190\t  padding: 2.25rem 0 2rem;\n191\t  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--gold);\n192\t}\n193\t.page-title { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; }\n194\t.page-desc { max-width: 42rem; color: var(--muted); }\n195\t.page-desc :first-child { margin-top: 0; }\n196\t.page-desc :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }\n197\t.page-header.region-0 { background: var(--region-0-tint); border-bottom-color: var(--region-0); }\n198\t.page-header.region-1 { background: var(--region-1-tint); border-bottom-color: var(--region-1); }\n199\t.page-header.region-2 { background: var(--region-2-tint); border-bottom-color: var(--region-2); }\n200\t.page-header.region-3 { background: var(--region-3-tint); border-bottom-color: var(--region-3); }\n201\t.page-header.region-4 { background: var(--region-4-tint); border-bottom-color: var(--region-4); }\n202\t.page-header.region-5 { background: var(--region-5-tint); border-bottom-color: var(--region-5); }\n203\t\n204\t/* -- sections and panels --------------------------------------------- */\n205\t.section { margin-top: var(--section-gap); }\n206\t.section-title {\n207\t  font-size: 1.6rem;\n208\t  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;\n209\t}\n210\t.section-title::after {\n211\t  content: \"\";\n212\t  display: block;\n213\t  width: 2.75rem;\n214\t  height: 3px;\n215\t  margin-top: 0.6rem;\n216\t  background: var(--gold);\n217\t  border-radius: 2px;\n218\t}\n219\t.panel {\n220\t  background: var(--panel);\n221\t  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n222\t  border-radius: 0.9rem;\n223\t  padding: 1.75rem 2rem;\n224\t  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(31, 22, 38, 0.05);\n225\t}\n226\t.empty-note h2 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 1.3rem; }\n227\t.empty-note p { margin-bottom: 0; color: var(--muted); }\n228\t\n229\t/* -- rendered Markdown ------------------------------------------------ */\n230\t.prose { max-width: 40rem; }\n231\t.prose > :first-child { margin-top: 0; }\n232\t.prose > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }\n233\t.prose h2 {\n234\t  font-size: 1.4rem;\n235\t  margin: 2.25rem 0 0.75rem;\n236\t}\n237\t.prose h3 { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: 1.75rem 0 0.5rem; }\n238\t.prose p { margin: 0 0 1.1rem; }\n239\t.prose ul, .prose ol { padding-left: 1.4rem; margin: 0 0 1.1rem; }\n240\t.prose li { margin: 0.35rem 0; }\n241\t.prose blockquote {\n242\t  margin: 1.75rem 0;\n243\t  padding: 0.25rem 0 0.25rem 1.5rem;\n244\t  border-left: 4px solid var(--gold);\n245\t  font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif;\n246\t  font-size: 1.2rem;\n247\t  line-height: 1.45;\n248\t  color: var(--purple-dark);\n249\t}\n250\t.prose blockquote p { margin: 0; }\n251\t.prose-tight { max-width: none; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--muted); }\n252\t.prose-tight p { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; }\n253\t\n254\t/* -- card grids: Continents, Countries, Programs, Posts -------------- */\n255\t.card-grid {\n256\t  list-style: none;\n257\t  display: grid;\n258\t  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));\n259\t  gap: 1.25rem;\n260\t  margin: 0;\n261\t  padding: 0;\n262\t}\n263\t/* Posts carry more text than a destination card, so they get wider tracks —\n264\t   which lands at two across on a desktop and one on a phone. */\n265\t.card-grid.card-grid-posts { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(24rem, 1fr)); }\n266\t/* A grid of only one or two cards (a Continent with one Country, a Country\n267\t   with two Programs) shouldn't stretch them into oversized banners or leave\n268\t   a lone card hugging the left edge — cap the width and center the row. */\n269\t.card-grid:has(> .card:only-child),\n270\t.card-grid:has(> .card:first-child:nth-last-child(2)) {\n271\t  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 22rem));\n272\t  justify-content: center;\n273\t}\n274\t.card {\n275\t  position: relative;\n276\t  display: flex;\n277\t  flex-direction: column;\n278\t  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n279\t  border-top: 4px solid var(--gold);\n280\t  border-radius: 0.75rem;\n281\t  padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem 1.25rem;\n282\t  background: var(--purple-light);\n283\t  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(31, 22, 38, 0.06);\n284\t  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;\n285\t}\n286\t.card:hover {\n287\t  transform: translateY(-4px);\n288\t  box-shadow: 0 16px 28px -12px rgba(31, 22, 38, 0.3);\n289\t}\n290\t.card.region-0 { border-top-color: var(--region-0); }\n291\t.card.region-1 { border-top-color: var(--region-1); }\n292\t.card.region-2 { border-top-color: var(--region-2); }\n293\t.card.region-3 { border-top-color: var(--region-3); }\n294\t.card.region-4 { border-top-color: var(--region-4); }\n295\t.card.region-5 { border-top-color: var(--region-5); }\n296\t.card-title, .post-card-title {\n297\t  font-size: 1.15rem;\n298\t  margin: 0;\n299\t}\n300\t.post-card-title { margin-top: 0.6rem; }\n301\t.card-link { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }\n302\t.card-link::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; }\n303\t.card:hover .card-link { color: var(--gold-dark); }\n304\t.card-desc {\n305\t  font-size: 0.92rem;\n306\t  color: var(--muted);\n307\t  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;\n308\t}\n309\t.card-stats {\n310\t  display: flex;\n311\t  flex-wrap: wrap;\n312\t  align-items: center;\n313\t  gap: 0.4rem;\n314\t  margin-top: 0.75rem;\n315\t}\n316\t.card-stat-count { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--purple-dark); }\n317\t.card-stat-topic {\n318\t  font-size: 0.75rem;\n319\t  color: var(--muted);\n320\t  background: var(--panel);\n321\t  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n322\t  border-radius: 999px;\n323\t  padding: 0.1rem 0.6rem;\n324\t}\n325\t.card-cta {\n326\t  display: block;\n327\t  margin-top: auto;\n328\t  padding-top: 0.75rem;\n329\t  border-top: 1px solid var(--card-border);\n330\t  font-size: 0.85rem;\n331\t  font-weight: 600;\n332\t  color: var(--purple-dark);\n333\t}\n334\t.card:hover .card-cta { color: var(--gold-dark); }\n335\t.info-card { background: var(--panel); }\n336\t.info-card-title { font-size: 1.2rem; margin: 0 0 0.6rem; }\n337\t\n338\t/* -- bylines ---------------------------------------------------------- */\n339\t.byline {\n340\t  display: flex;\n341\t  align-items: center;\n342\t  gap: 0.7rem;\n343\t  margin-top: auto;\n344\t  padding-top: 1rem;\n345\t}\n346\t.avatar {\n347\t  flex-shrink: 0;\n348\t  width: 2.25rem;\n349\t  height: 2.25rem;\n350\t  border-radius: 50%;\n351\t  background: var(--purple);\n352\t  color: #fff;\n353\t  font-size: 0.8rem;\n354\t  font-weight: 700;\n355\t  font-family: \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n356\t  display: flex;\n357\t  align-items: center;\n358\t  justify-content: center;\n359\t}\n360\t.avatar-lg { width: 3rem; --region-4-tint: #FAE9F3;\n  --region-5: #6B6356; --region-5-tint: #F1EEE9;\n}\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\nbody {\n  font: 16px/1.65 \"Inter\", system-ui, sans-serif;\n  margin: 0;\n  padding: 0;\n  min-height: 100vh;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  color: var(--ink);\n  background: var(--paper);\n  overflow-x: hidden;\n  overflow-wrap: anywhere;\n}\nh1, h2, h3 { font-family: \"Fraunces\", Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.2; }\na { color: var(--purple-dark); }\n:focus-visible {\n  outline: 3px solid var(--gold);\n  outline-offset: 2px;\n  border-radius: 2px;\n}\n.wrap {\n  max-width: 72rem;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 0 1.25rem;\n}\nmain { display: block;    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY email\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_user(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_user_role(user_id: int, role: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Change an existing user's role (Staff <-> Ambassador). This is a\n    plain role reassignment, not a deactivation — it never triggers the\n    deactivation cascade, since the user stays active throughout.\n    \"\"\"\n    if role not in (\"admin\", \"editor\"):\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid role: {role!r}\")\n    if get_user_by_id(user_id) is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"user {user_id} does not exist\")\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET role = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (role, user_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _set_user_active(user_id: int, active: bool) -> User:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET active = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (int(active), user_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef deactivate_user(user_id: int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Mark the user inactive, applying the role-specific cascade\n    (app.services.deactivation): an Ambassador's draft Posts are deleted; a\n    Staff member's drafts are left exactly as they are.    return _set_user_active(user_id, False)\n\n\ndef reactivate_user(user_id: int) -> User:\n    if get_user_by_id(user_id) is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"user {user_id} does not exist\")\n    return _set_user_active(user_id, True)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    id: int\n    parent_id: int | None\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: str\n    show_in_footer: bool\n    author_id: int | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_page(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        parent_id=row[\"parent_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n       row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id IS NULL\").fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef ensure_home_page() -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Create the single root Page (no parent) if it doesn't exist yet.\n\n    Guarded by a partial unique index (db.py: idx_pages_single_home) against\n    two concurrent first-requests both inserting a Home row; the loser's\n    insert raises IntegrityError here, and we just re-read the winner's row.\n    \"\"\"\n    home = get_home_page()\n    if home is not None:\n        return home\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id, published_at) \"\n            \"VALUES (NULL, 'Home', '', '', 'published', 0, NULL, \"\n            \"strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))\"\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return get_home_page()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_children(parent_id: int) -> list[Page]:\n    conn = AND status = 'published' \"\n            \"AND show_in_footer = 0 ORDER BY title\",\n            (parent_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_footer_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' AND show_in_footer = 1 \"\n            \"ORDER BY title\"\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_child_by_slug(parent_id: int, slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE parent_id = ? db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_ancestors(page: Page) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Home first, down to (but not including) `page` itself.\"\"\"\n    chain: list[Page] = []\n    current = page\n    while current.parent_id is not     sibling_slugs = {\n            c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef publish_page(page_id: int) -> Page:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE  (page_id,),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\n    page = WHERE id = ?\", (name, tag_id))\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_tag_by_id(tag_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_tag(tag_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM tags WHERE id = ?\", (tag_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\nTOPIC_CHOICES = [\n    (\"general\", \"General\"),\n    (\"housing\", \"Housing\"),\n    (\"meals\", \"Meals\"),\n    (\"social-life\", \"Social Life\"),\n    (\"academics\", \"Academics\"),\n    (\"other\", \"Other\"),\n]\nTOPIC_VALUES = {value for value, _label in TOPIC_CHOICES}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    program_id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    topic: str\n    status: str\n    author_id: int | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_post(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        program_id=row[\"program_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        topic=row[\"topic\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n        author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n        published_at=row[\"published_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef get_post_by_id(post_id: int) -> Post | None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_posts_by_program(program_id: int) -> list[Post]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM posts WHERE program_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC\",\n            (program_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_published_posts_by_program(program_id: int) -> list[Post]:\n    \"\"\"Public-facing: only published Posts, most recent first. A draft or\n    pending Post must never reach a public response (hard constraint).\"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM posts WHERE program_id = ? AND status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY published_at DESC\",\n            (program_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef backdate_post(post_id: int, timestamp: str) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"Move a Post's timestamps back in time. AND slug = ? AND status = 'published'\",\n            (program_id, slug),\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef group_posts_by_topic(posts: list[Post]) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[Post]]]:\n    \"\"\"Posts in Topic order (CONTEXT.md: General first, then each Hot Topic),\n    skipping any Topic with nothing to show.\"\"\"\n    buckets: dict[str, list[Post]] = {value: [] for value, _label in TOPIC_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        buckets[post.topic].append(post)\n    return [\n        (value, label, buckets[value])\n        for value, label in TOPIC_CHOICES\n        if buckets[value]\n    ]\n\n\ndef is_program_page(page: Page) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A Program is the Page three levels below Home (Home -> Continent ->\n    Country -> Program), per CONTEXT.md and the spec's Post.program_id field.\"\"\"\n    return len(list_ancestors(page)) == 3\n\n\ndef is_continent_page(page: Page) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A Continent is the Page one level below Home, minus the standalone\n    Pages that also sit at that depth (About CGE, Contact Us) — the same\n    show_in_footer split list_published_children already uses to keep\n    standalone Pages out of the Continent list that drives nav and\n    region_index. return home.id\n    ancestors = list_ancestors(page)\n    if len(ancestors) <= 1:\n        return page.id\n    return ancestors[1].id\n\n\ndef create_post(program_id: int, title: str, body: str, is_program_page(program):\n        raise ValueError(f\"page {program_id} is not a Program-level page\")\n    if topic not in TOPIC_VALUES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid topic: {topic!r}\")\n    sibling_slugs = {p.slug for p in list_posts_by_program(program_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (program_id, title, slug, body, topic, author_id) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (program_id, title, slug, body, topic, author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_post_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_post(post_id: int, title: str, body: str, topic: str) -> Post:\n    post = get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"post {post_id} does not exist\")\n    if topic not in TOPIC_VALUES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid topic: {topic!r}\")\n    if post.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            p.slug for p in list_posts_by_program(post.program_id) if p.id != post.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = post.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, topic = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, topic, post_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\nclass StatusConflict(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by set_post_status when the Post's status no longer matches\n    `from_status` — another request changed it between the caller's read and\n    this write, e.g. one admin bounced a pending Post the instant another\n    admin published it. The caller re-reads and re-authorizes rather than\n    overwriting a decision it never actually validated.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef set_post_status(post_id: int, from_status: str, to_status: str) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"Apply a review-gate transition (app.services.review_gate.transition\n    decides `to_status`; this is the one place that writes it), guarded by\n    `WHERE status = from_status` so a stale read can never clobber a status\n    change made in between. published_at is set on entry to 'published' and\n    cleared on any exit from it, so it never lingers on a Post that isn't\n    currently live.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        published_at_sql = (\n            \"published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), \"\n            if to_status == \"published\" else \"published_at = NULL, \"\n        )\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET status = ?, \" + published_at_sql +\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') \"\n            \"WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\",\n            (to_status, post_id, from_status),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise StatusConflict(\n                f\"post {post_id} is no longer {from_status!r}; refresh and retry\"\n            )\n        return get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_post(post_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_tags_for_post(post_id: int) -> list[Tag]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT tags.* FROM tags \"\n            \"JOIN post_tags ON post_tags.tag_id = tags.id \"\n            \"WHERE post_tags.post_id = ? ORDER BY tags.name\",\n            (post_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_tag(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_post_tags(post_id: int, tag_ids: list[int]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace a Post's Tags wholesale with `tag_ids` — the post form always\n    submits the full selected set (every checked checkbox), never a delta.\"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM post_tags WHERE post_id = ?\", (post_id,))\n        conn.executemany(\n            \"INSERT INTO post_tags (post_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n            [(post_id, tag_id) for tag_id in tag_ids],\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","numLines":724,"startLine":1,"totalLines":724}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a0640250-757f-4576-9e67-58525e54153d","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

endif %}\">\n              <h3 class=\"card-title\"><a class=\"card-link\" href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></h3>\n              {% if item.excerpt %}<p class=\"card-desc\">{{ item.excerpt }}</p>{% endif %}\n              {% if item.post_count is not none %}\n                <div class=\"card-stats\">\n                  <span class=\"card-stat-count\">{{ item.post_count }} post{{ \"s\" if item.post_count != 1 else \"\" }}</span>\n                  {% for topic in item.topics %}<span class=\"card-stat-topic\">{{ topic }}</span>{% endfor %}\n                </div>\n              {% endif %}\n              <span class=\"card-cta\">Explore &rarr;</span>\n            </li>\n          {% endfor %}\n        </ul>\n      </section>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    {% if post_groups is not none            <div class=\"tag-filters\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Filter by tag\">\n              <button type=\"button\" class=\"tag-pill is-active\" data-tag=\"all\">All tags</button>\n              {% for tag in tag_filters %}\n                <button type=\"button\" class=\"tag-pill\" data-tag=\"{{ tag.id }}\">{{ tag.name }}</button>\n              {% endfor %}\n            </div>\n          {% endif %}\n          {% for topic_value, topic_label, posts in post_groups %}\n            <section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{{ topic_value }}\">\n              <h3     var selectedTopic = \"all\";\n            var selectedTag = \"all\";\n\n            function apply() {\n              groups.forEach(function (g) {\n                var topicMatch = selectedTopic var tags = (card.getAttribute(\"data-tags\") || \"\").split(\",\").filter(Boolean);\n                  var visible = topicMatch && (selectedTag === \"all\" || tags.indexOf(selectedTag) !== -1);\n {"parentUuid":"a960f1fd-d9ba-4899-8bf3-bbc37d8b9ee6","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"de76ca71-a717-4a52-b238-6e620e2b35de","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015Azv6Ru8HpxfhRV3RYgfmr","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Turn published Posts into template-ready summaries, grouped by Topic.\n2\t\n3\tShared by app/publish.py (static export) and app/routes/public.py (live\n4\tpreview) so the two keep rendering the same grouping, byline, and date for\n5\tthe same data — same reason they already share app/models.py's queries and\n6\tapp/services/markdown.render.\n7\t\"\"\"\n8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n9\t\n10\tfrom typing import Callable\n11\t\n12\tfrom app import models\n13\tfrom app.services import markdown\n14\t\n15\tTOPIC_LABELS = dict(models.TOPIC_CHOICES)\n16\t\n17\t# How many distinct region accent colors app/publish.py's CSS defines\n18\t# (.region-0 .. .region-5) — cycles if Staff add a 7th Continent.\n19\tREGION_COUNT = 6\n20\t\n21\t\n22\t# The UI-facing name for each role, per CONTEXT.md's Role entry: admin shows\n23\t# as Staff, editor as Ambassador.\n24\tROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"Staff\", \"editor\": \"Ambassador\"}\n25\t\n26\t_MONTHS = [\"January\", \"February\", \"March\", \"April\", \"May\", \"June\", \"July\",\n27\t           \"August\", \"September\", \"October\", \"November\", \"December\"]\n28\t\n29\t\n30\tdef _author(post: models.Post) -> tuple[str, str]:\n31\t    \"\"\"-> (display name, UI role label) for a Post's byline.\"\"\"\n32\t    user = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n33\t    if user is None:\n34\t        return \"CGE Staff\", ROLE_LABELS[\"admin\"]\n35\t    return user.display_name, ROLE_LABELS.get(user.role, ROLE_LABELS[\"editor\"])\n36\t\n37\t\n38\tdef _published_date(post: models.Post) -> str:\n39\t    \"\"\"ISO stamp -> \"6 October 2026\". Falls back to the raw date if the stamp\n40\t    isn't the shape SQLite writes.\"\"\"\n41\t    stamp = (post.published_at or post.created_at or \"\")[:10]\n42\t    try:\n43\t        year, month, day = (int(part) for part in stamp.split(\"-\"))\n44\t        return f\"{day} {_MONTHS[month - 1]} {year}\"\n45\t    except (ValueError, IndexError):\n46\t        return stamp\n47\t\n48\t\n49\tdef _initials(name: str) -> str:\n50\t    letters = \"\".join(part[0] for part in name.split()[:2])\n51\t    return letters.upper() or \"?\"\n52\t\n53\t\n54\tdef post_summary(post: models.Post, href: str) -> dict:\n55\t    author_name, author_role = _author(post)\n56\t    return {\n57\t        \"post\": post,\n58\t        \"href\": href,\n59\t        \"title\": post.title,\n60\t        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(post.body),\n61\t        \"topic_value\": post.topic,\n62\t        \"topic_label\": TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic],\n63\t        \"tags\": models.get_tags_for_post(post.id),\n64\t        \"author_name\": author_name,\n65\t        \"author_role\": author_role,\n66\t        \"author_initials\": _initials(author_name),\n67\t        \"published_date\": _published_date(post),\n68\t    }\n69\t\n70\t\n71\tdef distinct_tags(post_groups: list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]) -> list[models.Tag]:\n72\t    \"\"\"Every Tag actually used by a Program's currently-shown Posts, in name\n73\t    order — the options for its reader-facing Tag filter. A Tag nobody on\n74\t    this Program has used yet is left out, same as `group_posts_by_topic`\n75\t    omits an empty Topic.\"\"\"\n76\t    seen: dict[int, models.Tag] = {}\n77\t    for _value, _label, summaries in post_groups:\n78\t        for summary in summaries:\n79\t            for tag in summary[\"tags\"]:\n80\t                seen[tag.id] = tag\n81\t    return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda t: t.name)\n82\t\n83\t\n84\tdef children_heading(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n85\t    \"\"\"What to call a Page's list of child Pages, in the reader's words\n86\t    rather than the tree's: Home browses regions, a Continent lists its\n87\t    Countries, a Country lists its Programs.\"\"\"\n88\t    if page.id == home.id:\n89\t        return \"Explore by region\"\n90\t    if models.is_continent_page(page):\n91\t        return f\"Countries in {page.title}\"\n92\t    if models.is_country_page(page):\n93\t        return f\"Programs in {page.title}\"\n94\t    return \"Pages\"\n95\t\n96\t\n97\tdef region_index(page: models.Page, home: models.Page, continents: list[models.Page]) -> int | None:\n98\t    \"\"\"Which Continent's accent color governs `page` — None for Home itself,\n99\t    otherwise the index (mod REGION_COUNT) of the Continent that page lives\n100\t    under (or, if `page` is itself a Continent, its own index). Shared by\n101\t    every card and page-header band so a Continent's whole subtree (its\n102\t    Country and Program pages too) reads in one consistent accent color.\"\"\"\n103\t    if page.id == home.id:\n104\t        return None\n105\t    root_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n106\t    for i, continent in enumerate(continents):\n107\t        if continent.id == root_id:\n108\t            return i % REGION_COUNT\n109\t    return None\n110\t\n111\t\n112\tdef program_stats(program_id: int) -> dict:\n113\t    \"\"\"Published-post count and the distinct Topic labels present, for a\n114\t    Program's card on its parent Country's listing.\"\"\"\n115\t    posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(program_id)\n116\t    topics: list[str] = []\n117\t    seen: set[str] = set()\n118\t    for post in posts:\n119\t        if post.topic not in seen:\n120\t            seen.add(post.topic)\n121\t            topics.append(TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic])\n122\t    return {\"post_count\": published Posts into template-ready summaries, grouped by Topic.\n\nShared by app/publish.py (static export) and app/routes/public.py (live\npreview) so the two keep rendering the same grouping, byline, and date for\nthe same data — same reason they already share app/models.py's queries and\napp/services/markdown.render.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\nTOPIC_LABELS = dict(models.TOPIC_CHOICES)\n\n# How many distinct region accent colors app/publish.py's CSS defines\n# (.region-0 .. .region-5) — cycles if Staff add a 7th Continent.\nREGION_COUNT = 6\n\n\n# The UI-facing name for each role, per CONTEXT.md's Role entry: admin shows\n# as Staff, editor as Ambassador.\nROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"Staff\", \"editor\": \"Ambassador\"}\n\n_MONTHS = [\"January\", \"February\", \"March\", \"April\", \"May\", \"June\", \"July\",\n           \"August\", \"September\", \"October\", \"November\", \"December\"]\n\n\ndef _author(post: models.Post) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"-> (display name, UI role label) for a Post's byline.\"\"\"\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n    if user is None:\n        return \"CGE Staff\", ROLE_LABELS[\"admin\"]\n    return user.display_name, ROLE_LABELS.get(user.role, ROLE_LABELS[\"editor\"])\n\n\ndef _published_date(post: models.Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"ISO stamp -> \"6 October 2026\". Falls back to the raw date if the stamp\n    isn't the shape SQLite writes.\"\"\"\n    stamp = (post.published_at or post.created_at or \"\")[:10]\n    try:\n        year, month, day = (int(part) for part in stamp.split(\"-\"))\n        return f\"{day} {_MONTHS[month - 1]} {year}\"\n    except (ValueError, IndexError):\n        return stamp\n\n\ndef _initials(name: str) -> str:\n    letters = \"\".join(part[0] for part in name.split()[:2])\n    return letters.upper() or \"?\"\n\n\ndef post_summary(post: models.Post, href: str) -> dict:\n    author_name, author_role = _author(post)\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"title\": post.title,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(post.body),\n        \"topic_value\": post.topic,\n        \"topic_label\": TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic],\n        \"tags\": models.get_tags_for_post(post.id),\n        \"author_name\": author_name,\n        \"author_role\": author_role,\n        \"author_initials\": _initials(author_name),\n        \"published_date\": _published_date(post),\n    }\n\n\ndef distinct_tags(post_groups: list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]) -> list[models.Tag]:\n    \"\"\"Every Tag actually used by a Program's currently-shown Posts, in name\n    order — the options for its reader-facing Tag filter. A Tag nobody on\n    this Program has used yet is left out, same as `group_posts_by_topic`\n    omits an empty Topic.\"\"\"\n    seen: dict[int, models.Tag] = {}\n    for _value, _label, summaries in post_groups:\n        for summary in summaries:\n            for tag in summary[\"tags\"]:\n                seen[tag.id] = tag\n    return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda t: t.name)\n\n\ndef children_heading(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    \"\"\"What to call a Page's list of child Pages, in the reader's words\n    rather than the tree's: Home browses regions, a Continent lists its\n    Countries, a Country lists its Programs.\"\"\"\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"Explore by region\"\n    if models.is_continent_page(page):\n        return f\"Countries in {page.title}\"\n    if models.is_country_page(page):\n        return f\"Programs in {page.title}\"\n    return \"Pages\"\n\n\ndef region_index(page: models.Page, home: models.Page, continents: list[models.Page]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Which Continent's accent color governs `page` — None for Home itself,\n    otherwise the index (mod REGION_COUNT) of the Continent that page lives\n    under (or, if `page` is itself a Continent, its own index). Shared by\n    every card and page-header band so a Continent's whole subtree (its\n    Country and Program pages too) reads in one consistent accent color.\"\"\"\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return None\n    root_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    for i, continent in enumerate(continents):\n        if continent.id == root_id:\n            return i % REGION_COUNT\n    return None\n\n\ndef program_stats(program_id: int) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Published-post count and the distinct Topic labels present, for a\n    Program's card on its parent Country's listing.\"\"\"\n    posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(program_id)\n    topics: list[str] = []\n    seen: set[str] = set()\n    for post in posts:\n        if post.topic not in seen:\n            seen.add(post.topic)\n            topics.append(TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic])\n    return {\"post_count\": len(posts), \"topics\": topics}\n\n\ndef page_card(\n    page: models.Page,\n    href: str,\n    home: models.Page,\n    continents: list[models.Page],\n    stats: dict | None = None,\n) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"A Continent/Country/Program's card on its parent's listing: title,\n    href, a short description teased from the Page's own body, its region\n    accent, and — for a Program card — its post count and Topics.\"\"\"\n    return {\n        \"title\": page.title,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"excerpt\": markdown.excerpt(page.body),\n        \"region\": region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"post_count\": stats[\"post_count\"] if stats else None,\n        \"topics\": stats[\"topics\"] if stats else None,\n    }\n\n\ndef grouped_post_summaries(\n    posts: list[models.Post], href_for: Callable[[models.Post], str]\n) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(topic_value, topic_label, [post_summary, ...]), ...], Topics with\n    no published Posts omitted.\"\"\"\n    groups = models.group_posts_by_topic(posts)\n    return [\n        (value, label, [post_summary(post, href_for(post)) for post in group_posts])\n        for value, label, group_posts in groups\n    ]\n","numLines":155,"startLine":1,"totalLines":155}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a960f1fd-d9ba-4899-8bf3-bbc37d8b9ee6","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"e0b66bf9-0ffd-4556-88c7-c4e4f934864f","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"de76ca71-a717-4a52-b238-6e620e2b35de","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018dpQ1WiPm97FTLFyStgcWB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n2\t\n3\t    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n4\t    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n5\t    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\timport argparse\n10\timport subprocess\n11\timport sys\n12\t\n13\tfrom app import settings\n14\tfrom app.publish import render_site\n15\t\n16\t\n17\tdef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n18\t    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n19\t    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n20\t    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n21\t    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n22\t    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n23\t    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n24\t    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n25\t    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n26\t    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n27\t\n28\t    if args.command == \"serve\":\n29\t        import uvicorn\n30\t\n31\t        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n32\t        return 0\n33\t\n34\t    if args.command == \"publish\":\n35\t        out = render_site()\n36\t        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n37\t        return 0\n38\t\n39\t    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n40\t        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n41\t            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n42\t            return 1\n43\t        result = subprocess.run(\n44\t            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n45\t             str(settings.SITE)],\n46\t        )\n47\t        if result.returncode == 0:\n48\t            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n49\t                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n50\t        return result.returncode\n51\t    return 1\n52\t\n53\t\n54\tif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n55\t    raise SystemExit(main())\n56\t"}]},"uuid":"91c9e6bb-2a26-40c4-881f-ed51f2a6a6a5","timestamp":"2026-10-07T02:19:22.609Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/cli.py","content":"\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. The first paragraph heads\n    the page (inside the tinted band); the rest renders in a panel below, so\n    a long body never turns the band into the whole page.\"\"\"\n    stripped = markdown_text.strip()\n    if not stripped:\n        return \"\", \"\"\n    head, separator, tail = stripped.partition(\"\\n\\n\")\n    if head.lstrip().startswith(\"##\"):  # a body that opens with a section\n        return \"\", stripped\n    return head.strip(), tail.strip() if separator else \"\"\n\n\ndef split_sections(markdown_text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(heading, body markdown), ...] for each \"## Heading\" in the text.\n    A standalone Page renders these as cards, so Staff get a structured\n    layout by writing ordinary Markdown sections — no template change.\"\"\"\n    matches = list(_H2_SPLIT.finditer(markdown_text))\n    sections = []\n    for i, match in enumerate(matches):\n        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(markdown_text)\n        sections.append((match.group(1).strip(), markdown_text[match.end():end].strip()))\n    return sections\n\n\ndef strip_sections(markdown_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text before the first \"## Heading\" — the part split_sections leaves\n    behind.\"\"\"\n    match = _H2_SPLIT.search(markdown_text)\n    return markdown_text[: match.start()].strip() if match else markdown_text.strip()\n","numLines":80,"startLine":1,"totalLines":80}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"01f8e647-5b07-4792-bbdc-191a6c9d72c6","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n_LINK_RE = re.compile(r'(?:href|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT test_exported_site_has_no_broken_internal_links(client, tmp_path):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    html_files = list(out.rglob(\"index.html\"))\n    assert html_files, \"render_site produced no pages to crawl\"\n\n    broken: list[str] = []\n    for html_file in html_files:\n        html = html_file.read_text()\n        for link in _LINK_RE.findall(html):\n            if link.startswith((\"http://\", \"https://\", \"mailto:\", \"#\", \"data:\")):\n                continue\n            # The stylesheet carries a \"?v=\" cache-buster, and a link may end\n            # in a fragment; neither is part of the path on disk.\n            path = link.split(\"#\", 1)[0].split(\"?\", 1)[0]\n            if not path:\n                continue\n            target = (html_file.parent / path).resolve()\n            if not target.exists():\n                broken.append(f\"{html_file.relative_to(out)} -> {link}\")\n\n    assert not broken, \"broken internal link(s):\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(broken)\n\n\ndef test_footer_pages_are_published_with_real_content_and_resolve(client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"The specific regression: About CGE and Contact Us must be seeded as\n    published standalone Pages with real (non-placeholder) bodies, and their\n    footer links must resolve to an actual exported page.\"\"\"\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n\n    for title, slug in [(\"About CGE\", \"about-cge\"), (\"Contact Us\", \"contact-us\")]:\n        page = models.get_child_by_slug(models.ensure_home_page().id, slug)\n        assert page is not None, f\"{title} was not seeded\"\n        assert page.status == \"published\"\n        assert page.show_in_footer is True\n        assert \"Placeholder copy\" not in page.body\n        assert len(page.body) > 40\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    home_html = (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"about-cge/index.html\"' in home_html\n    assert 'href=\"contact-us/index.html\"' in home_html\n    assert (out / \"about-cge\" / \"index.html\").exists()\n    assert (out / \"contact-us\" / \"index.html\").exists()\n\n    contact_html = (out / {"parentUuid":"84caacf4-e962-479b-86d7-a953ccee149c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"de76ca71-a717-4a52-b238-6e620e2b35de","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014ecdzaj63pUS1nLf6xsQow","type":"tool_result","content":"Kenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement (CGE) wants its own site where student Ambassadors who've actually attended a program write about it, but CGE must review every post before it goes public — nothing unapproved can reach a reader, and an Ambassador must never be able to touch anyone else's writing or the site's structure.\n\n## Solution\n\nA CMS with two roles — **Staff** (admin) and **Ambassador** (editor), see `CONTEXT.md` — where Ambassadors write and submit Posts, Staff review and publish them, and the public site is a static export organized as Home → Continent → Country → Program, with Posts grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page. `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003`, `ADR-004` are the settled vocabulary and decisions this spec builds on; `notes/future-work.md` lists what's deliberately deferred.\n\n## User Stories\n\n**Login (capability 1)**\n1. As a Staff member, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access the admin console.\n2. As an Ambassador, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can write and manage my own posts.\n3. As any user, I want a wrong password refused without the response revealing whether the account exists, so that no one can probe for valid emails.\n4. As a deactivated user, I want my login refused, so that I can't access the system after my account is deactivated.\n5. As any logged-in user, I want to log out, so that I can end my session on a shared computer.\n\n**Roles (capability 2)**\n6. As a Staff member, I want every Ambassador capability available to me too, so that I can write and submit my own Posts without a second account.\n7. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from any admin-only route, so that I can't reach user management or page authoring.\n8. As an anonymous visitor, I want to be redirected to login when I request an admin route, so that the admin console stays private.\n\n**Posts: authoring and the review gate (capability 3, ADR-004)**\n--\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"a9d2f7b2-3fec-4de3-810a-ed8e40967ebc","timestamp":"2026-10-07T02:19:49.684Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"Kenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics).        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n        return None\n    return \"page\", current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != page.id]\n    children = models.list_published_children(page.id)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    is_country = models.is_country_page(page)\n\n    post_groups = None\n    tag_filters = None\n    if models.is_program_page(page):\n        page_href = _path_for(page, home)\n        posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n        post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n            posts, lambda post: page_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n        )\n        tag_filters = post_view.distinct_tags(post_groups)\n\n    intro_md, rest_md = markdown.split_intro(page.body)\n    sections = []\n    if models.is_standalone_page(page):\n        sections = [\n            {\"heading\": heading, \"body_html\": markdown.render(body)}\n            for heading, body in markdown.split_sections(rest_md)\n        ]\n        rest_md = markdown.strip_sections(rest_md)\n\n    return {\n        \"page\": page,\n        \"intro_html\": markdown.render(intro_md),\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(rest_md),\n        \"sections\": sections,\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            post_view.page_card(\n                c, _path_for(c, home), home, continents,\n                stats=post_view.program_stats(c.id) if is_country else None,\n            )\n            for c in children\n        ],\n        \"children_heading\": post_view.children_heading(page, home),\n        \"post_groups\": post_groups,\n        \"tag_filters\": tag_filters,\n    }\n\n\ndef post_context(post: models.Post, program: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(program) if a.id != program.id]\n    program_href = _path_for(program, home)\n    post_href = program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n    summary = post_view.post_summary(post, post_href)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(program, home)\n    more_from = [\n        post_view.post_summary(other, program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{other.slug}/\")\n        for other in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n        if other.id != post.id\n    ][:2]\n\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(post.body),\n        \"topic_label\": summary[\"topic_label\"],\n        \"tags\": summary[\"tags\"],\n        \"author_name\": summary[\"author_name\"],\n        \"author_role\": summary[\"author_role\"],\n        \"author_initials\": summary[\"author_initials\"],\n        \"published_date\": summary[\"published_date\"],\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(program, home, continents),\n        \"more_from\": more_from,\n        \"program_href\": program_href,\n        \"program_title\": program.title,\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": program.title, \"href\": program_href}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    resolved = resolve(path)\n    if resolved is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    if resolved[0] == \"post\":\n        _kind, post, program = resolved\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/post.html\",\n            {\"title\": post.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **post_context(post, program)},\n        )\n\n    _kind, page = resolved\n    if page.status != \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\",\n        {\"title\": page.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **page_context(page)},\n    )\n","numLines":166,"startLine":1,"totalLines":166}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ca66c9f4-5595-4dac-ba9f-3f600d252277","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"d53dd240-42bd-49c4-b0b3-baceecaca33a","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"de76ca71-a717-4a52-b238-6e620e2b35de","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Qs63te3h5bUDwN4x1qaaTq","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role — it works as soon as your login route exists,\nso access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n              \"display_name\": \"Dana Whitfield\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\",\n               \"display_name\": \"Jordan Avery\"},\n}\nDEACTIVATED_USER = {\"email\": \"deactivated@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-deactivated-pw\"}\n\n_CSRF_RE = re.compile(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef _csrf_token_from(html: str) -> str:\n    match = _CSRF_RE.search(html)\n    return match.group(1) if match else \"\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef seeded_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Point the app at a fresh per-test SQLite file, seeded with DEMO_USERS\n    plus one deactivated user — independent of the developer's own .env.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, Keep this file small.\n9\t\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\tfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\n13\tfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\n14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n15\t\n16\tfrom app import db, settings\n17\tfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public, tags\n18\tfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n19\t\n20\t\n21\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n22\t    db.init_db()\n23\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n24\t    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n25\t                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n26\t\n27\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n28\t    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n29\t        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n30\t\n31\t    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n32\t    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n33\t        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n34\t\n35\t    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n36\t    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n37\t        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n38\t\n39\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n40\t    app.include_router(pages.router)\n41\t    app.include_router(posts.router)\n42\t    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n43\t    app.include_router(tags.router)\n44\t    app.include_router(console.router)\n45\t\n46\t    # That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, pages, posts, public, tags\nfrom app.routes.auth import AdminRequired, CsrfInvalid, LoginRequired\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(tags.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n","numLines":53,"startLine":1,"totalLines":53}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9e77e194-a750-41e6-93d7-a4b5dfa0b286","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

python3\n\"\"\"Screenshot pages with Playwright, for the design-review passes T11+ ask for.\n\n    uv run python scripts/screenshot.py --out notes/screenshots \\\\\n        --widths 1280 390 \\\\\n        --path / home \\\\\n        --path /asia/ asia\n\nStarts the real app (`app.main:app`) on a throwaway port, waits for it to\ncome up, then drives headless Chromium to capture each --path at each\n--width as \"<name>-<width>.png\" under --out. Pass --login EMAIL PASSWORD to\nauthenticate first (needed for admin screenshots).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport socket\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport urllib.request\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _free_port() -> int:\n    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:\n        s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\", 0))\n        return s.getsockname()[1]\n\n\ndef _wait_for(url: str, timeout: float = 15.0) -> None:\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        try:\n            urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=1)\n            return\n        except OSError:\n            time.sleep(0.2)\n    raise RuntimeError(f\"server never came up at {url}\")\n\n\ndef _login(page, base: str, email: str, password: str) -> None:\n    page.goto(base + \"/login\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n    token = page.get_attribute('input[name=\"csrf_token\"]', \"value\")\n    page.fill('input[name=\"email\"]', email)\n    page.fill('input[name=\"password\"]', password)\n    page.click('button[type=\"submit\"]')\n    page.wait_for_load_state(\"networkidle\")\n    if token is None:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"login page had no csrf_token field\")\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--out\", required=True, type=Path)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--widths\", nargs=\"+\", type=int, default=[1280, 390])\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--path\", nargs=2, action=\"append\", metavar=(\"URL_PATH\", \"NAME\"),\n        default=[], dest=\"paths\", help=\"repeatable: a URL path and a filename stem\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--login\", nargs=2, metavar=(\"EMAIL\", \"PASSWORD\"), default=None,\n        help=\"log in with these creds before screenshotting\",\n    )\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if not args.paths:\n        parser.error(\"pass at least one --path URL_PATH NAME\")\n\n    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    port = _free_port()\n    base = f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\"\n\n    server = subprocess.Popen(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"uvicorn\", \"app.main:app\", \"--port\", str(port)],\n        cwd=ROOT,\n    )\n    try:\n        _wait_for(base + \"/\")\n        with sync_playwright() as p:\n            browser = p.chromium.launch()\n            for width in args.widths:\n                context = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 900})\n                page = context.new_page()\n                if args.login:\n                    _login(page, base, *args.login)\n                for url_path, name in args.paths:\n                    page.goto(base + url_path, wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n                    page.screenshot(path=str(args.out / f\"{name}-{width}.png\"), full_page=True)\n                context.close()\n            browser.close()\n    finally:\n        server.terminate()\n        try:\n            server.wait(timeout=10)\n        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n            server.kill()\n            server.wait(timeout=10)\n\n    print(f\"Saved screenshots to {args.out}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n","numLines":110,"startLine":1,"totalLines":110}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7cf89ccf-e8d5-4df5-b827-77a73a2d76b8","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}
