Pure given its inputs: no FastAPI or SQLite.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nimport nh3\n\n_md = MarkdownIt()\n_MD_LIST_BULLET = re.compile(r\"(?m)^[ \\t]*[-*+][ \\t]+\")\n# Styling markers that always sit directly against a word (**bold**, `code`,\n# # heading, > quote) — safe to delete outright. Deleting rather than\n# spacing these out avoids a stray space before trailing punctuation, e.g.\n# \"**Africa**.\" must become \"Africa.\", not \"Africa .\"\n_MD_STYLE_MARKERS = re.compile(r\"[#>*_`]\")\n# Link/image punctuation ([text](url), ![alt](url)) separates two tokens\n# that aren't otherwise space-separated, so these are replaced with a space\n# instead of deleted, to avoid gluing \"text\" and \"url\" together.\n_MD_LINK_PUNCT = re.compile(r\"[!\\[\\]()]\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"\\s+\")\n# Catches any stray space left before trailing punctuation by the\n# substitutions above, however it got there — e.g. \"[text](url).\" stripping\n# to \"text url .\" without this, since the \".\" follows a deleted \")\".\n_SPACE_BEFORE_PUNCT = re.compile(r\"\\s+([.,;:!?])\")\n# A \"## Heading\" line, which splits a Page's body into the intro that heads\n# the page and the sections rendered below it as cards.\n_H2_SPLIT = re.compile(r\"(?m)^##[ \\t]+(.+?)[ \\t]*$\")\n\n\ndef render(markdown_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render Markdown to HTML and strip anything an Ambassador could use to\n    inject a script (hard constraint: sanitize before rendering anywhere).\"\"\"\n    return nh3.clean(_md.render(markdown_text))\n\n\ndef excerpt(markdown_text: str, length: int = 140) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Plain-text teaser for a card: strip common Markdown markers, collapse\n    whitespace, and cut at a word boundary. Never marked `| safe` by callers,\n    so no sanitization is needed here — Jinja autoescapes it like any text.\"\"\"\n    no_bullets = _MD_LIST_BULLET.sub(\"\", markdown_text)\n    no_style = _MD_STYLE_MARKERS.sub(\"\", no_bullets)\n    no_link_punct = _MD_LINK_PUNCT.sub(\" \", no_style)\n    collapsed = _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", no_link_punct).strip()\n    plain = _SPACE_BEFORE_PUNCT.sub(r\"\\1\", collapsed)\n    if len(plain) <= length:\n        return plain\n    return plain[:length].rsplit(\" \", 1)[0] + \"…\"\n\n\ndef split_intro(markdown_text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"-> (first paragraph, everything after it). The first paragraph heads\n    the page (inside the tinted band); the rest renders in a panel below, so\n    a long body never turns the band into the whole page.\"\"\"\n    stripped = markdown_text.strip()\n    if not stripped:\n        return \"\", \"\"\n    head, separator, tail = stripped.partition(\"\\n\\n\")\n    if head.lstrip().startswith(\"##\"):  # a body that opens with a section\n        return \"\", stripped\n    return head.strip(), tail.strip() if separator else \"\"\n\n\ndef split_sections(markdown_text: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(heading, body markdown), ...] for each \"## Heading\" in the text.\n    A standalone Page renders these as cards, so Staff get a structured\n    layout by writing ordinary Markdown sections — no template change.\"\"\"\n    matches = list(_H2_SPLIT.finditer(markdown_text))\n    sections = []\n    for i, match in enumerate(matches):\n        end = matches[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(matches) else len(markdown_text)\n        sections.append((match.group(1).strip(), markdown_text[match.end():end].strip()))\n    return sections\n\n\ndef strip_sections(markdown_text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text before the first \"## Heading\" — the part split_sections leaves\n    behind.\"\"\"\n    match = _H2_SPLIT.search(markdown_text)\n    return markdown_text[: match.start()].strip() if match else markdown_text.strip()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":15,"newStart":33,"newLines":22,"lines":["     return nh3.clean(_md.render(markdown_text))"," "," ","-def excerpt(markdown_text: str, length: int = 140) -> str:","-    \"\"\"Plain-text teaser for a card: strip common Markdown markers, collapse","-    whitespace, and cut at a word boundary. {"parentUuid":"ebb35228-942f-49c5-badf-fdbf63c8e40f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfn5nYPeFKiX2AGmD3Cst","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DjRgffk7X8kTLtLC4TTXuM","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/search_index.py","content":"\"\"\"Build the client-side search index (#10): one entry per published Post —\ntitle, body text, and tags — scoped to its owning Program's slug chain so a\nContinent/Country/Program page's search box can filter to its own subtree.\n\nShared by app/publish.py (writes it as a static search-index.json) and\napp/routes/public.py (serves the same shape live, for the admin preview).\nSearch itself runs entirely in the browser against whichever of those two\nthis module produced — this module only ever reads, never serves a query.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import markdown\n\n\ndef build_index(href_for: Callable[[list[str]], str]) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"`href_for` turns a Post's full slug chain (ancestors + Program + Post)\n    into the link a search result should point at — the one thing that\n    differs between a static export (relative, .../index.html) and the live\n    preview (root-absolute, matching app.routes.public's own route shape).\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    entries: list[dict] = []\n    for page in models.list_all_pages():\n        if page.status != \"published\" or not models.is_program_page(page):\n            continue\n        chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + [page.slug]\n        for post in (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"b9b3c183-441f-43a0-96de-8739dfdbe1bc","timestamp":"2026-10-07T02:25:59.602Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/routes/public.py","oldString":"from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view","newString":"from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view, search_index","originalFile":"\"\"\"The public site, served live from the database.\n\nThis is the admin console's \"preview\" the Pages ticket asks for: Staff see a\npublished change here immediately, before anyone runs `cms publish`. It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import JSONResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view, search_index\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n        return None\n    return \"page\", current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != page.id]\n    children = models.list_published_children(page.id)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(page, home)\n    is_country = models.is_country_page(page)\n    is_program = models.is_program_page(page)\n    chain = [a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != home.id] + (\n        [page.slug] if page.id != home.id else []\n    )\n    search_scope_chain = (\n        chain if (models.is_continent_page(page) or is_country or is_program) else None\n    )\n\n    post_groups = None\n    tag_filters = None\n    if is_program:\n        page_href = _path_for(page, home)\n        posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n        post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n            posts, lambda post: page_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n        )\n        tag_filters = post_view.distinct_tags(post_groups)\n\n    intro_md, rest_md = markdown.split_intro(page.body)\n    sections = []\n    if models.is_standalone_page(page):\n        sections = [\n            {\"heading\": heading, \"body_html\": markdown.render(body)}\n            for heading, body in markdown.split_sections(rest_md)\n        ]\n        rest_md = markdown.strip_sections(rest_md)\n\n    return {\n        \"page\": page,\n        \"intro_html\": markdown.render(intro_md),\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(rest_md),\n        \"sections\": sections,\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(page, home, continents),\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\", \"active\": active_id == home.id}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home), \"active\": active_id == c.id}\n            for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            post_view.page_card(\n                c, _path_for(c, home), home, continents,\n                stats=post_view.program_stats(c.id) if is_country else None,\n            )\n            for c in children\n        ],\n        \"children_heading\": post_view.children_heading(page, home),\n        \"post_groups\": post_groups,\n        \"tag_filters\": tag_filters,\n        \"site_root\": \"\",\n        \"search_index_href\": \"/search-index.json\",\n        \"search_scope_chain\": search_scope_chain,\n    }\n\n\ndef post_context(post: models.Post, program: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(program) if a.id != program.id]\n    program_href = _path_for(program, home)\n    post_href = program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n    summary = post_view.post_summary(post, post_href)\n    active_id = models.nav_root_id(program, home)\n    more_from = [\n        post_view.post_summary(other, program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{other.slug}/\")\n        for other in models.list_published_posts_by_program(program.id)\n        if other.id != post.id\n    ][:2]\n\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(post.body),\n        \"topic_label\": summary[\"topic_label\"],\n        \"tags\": summary[\"tags\"],\n        \"author_name\": summary[\"author_name\"],\n        \"author_role\": summary[\"author_role\"],\n        \"author_initials\": summary[\"author_initials\"],\n        \"published_date\": summary[\"published_date\"],\n        \"region\": post_view.region_index(program, \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": program.title, \"href\": program_href}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    resolved = resolve(path)\n    if resolved is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    if resolved[0] == \"post\":\n        _kind, post, program = resolved\n        return resolved\n    if page.status != \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\",\n        {\"title\": href=\"{{ css_path }}\">{% endif %}\n  {# `| safe` because this is app.publish.CSS, a server-side constant, never\n     user content — and inside <style> Jinja's HTML escaping is wrong anyway:\n     it turns a child combinator into \"&gt;\" and silently drops the rule, so\n     the live preview stops matching the exported stylesheet. #}\n  {% if inline_css %}<style>{{ inline_css | safe }}</style>{% endif %}\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header class=\"site-header\">\n    <div class=\"wrap header-inner\">\n      <a class=\"wordmark\" href=\"{{ nav[0].href }}\">Kenyon CGE Study Abroad</a>\n      <nav class=\"site-nav\">\n        {% for item in nav %}<a href=\"{{ item.href }}\"{% if item.active %} class=\"is-active\"{% endif %}>{{ item.title }}</a>{% endfor %}\n      </nav>\n      {% if search_index_href %}\n      <div class=\"site-search site-search--header\" data-search-root>\n        <form class=\"search-form\" role=\"search\" onsubmit=\"return false;\">\n          <input type=\"search\" class=\"search-input\" placeholder=\"Search the site\" aria-label=\"Search the whole site\">\n          <span class=\"search-fields\">\n            <label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"search-field\" value=\"title\" checked> Title</label>\n            <label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"search-field\" value=\"text\" checked> Text</label>\n            <label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"search-field\" value=\"tags\" checked> Tags</label>\n          </span>\n        </form>\n        <ul class=\"search-results\" hidden></ul>\n      </div>\n      {% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer class=\"site-footer\">\n    <div class=\"wrap\">\n      <div class=\"footer-grid\">\n        <div class=\"footer-brand\">\n          <h2>Kenyon CGE Study Abroad</h2>\n          <p>Posts from Kenyon students living and studying abroad, program by program.</p>\n        </div>\n        {% if footer_links %}\n        <nav class=\"site-footer-nav\">\n          {% for item in footer_links %}<a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a>{% endfor %}\n        </nav>\n        {% endif %}\n      </div>\n      <small class=\"footer-note\">Demo site built for IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2 — not an official Kenyon College page.</small>\n    </div>\n  </footer>\n  {% if search_index_href %}\n  <script>\n    /* Client-side search (#10) against search-index.json — no server-side\n       component. Shared between the sitewide box (every page, unscoped) and\n       a Continent/Country/Program page's own scoped box (public/page.html),\n       so both filter the same fetched index instead of each doing its own\n       request. Results are built with DOM methods, never innerHTML, because\n       a Post's title and tags are Ambassador-authored text. */\n    window.CGESearch = (function () {\n      var indexPromise = null;\n\n      function loadIndex(url) {\n        if (!indexPromise) {\n          indexPromise = fetch(url)\n            .then(function (response) { return response.json(); })\n            .catch(function () { return []; });\n        }\n        return indexPromise;\n      }\n\n      function activeFields(root) {\n        var fields = [];\n        root.querySelectorAll(\".search-field\").forEach(function (box) {\n          if (box.checked) fields.push(box.value);\n        });\n        return fields;\n      }\n\n      function matches(entry, term, fields) {\n        var haystacks = [];\n        if (fields.indexOf(\"title\") !== -1) haystacks.push(entry.title);\n        if (fields.indexOf(\"text\") !== -1) haystacks.push(entry.text);\n        if (fields.indexOf(\"tags\") !== -1) haystacks.push(entry.tags.join(\" \"));\n        return haystacks.some(function (text) {\n          return (text || \"\").toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1;\n        });\n      }\n\n      function inScope(entry, scope) {\n        if (!scope) return true;\n        return entry.chain.slice(0, scope.length).join(\"/\") === scope.join(\"/\");\n      }\n\n      function renderResults(list, matched, siteRoot) {\n        list.textContent = \"\";\n        if (!matched.length) {\n          var empty = document.createElement(\"li\");\n          empty.className = \"search-empty\";\n          empty.textContent = \"No results.\";\n          list.appendChild(empty);\n          return;\n        }\n        matched.slice(0, 20).forEach(function (entry) {\n          var item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n          item.className = \"search-result\";\n          var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n          link.href = siteRoot + entry.href;\n          link.textContent = entry.title;\n          item.appendChild(link);\n          if (entry.tags.length) {\n            var tags = document.createElement(\"span\");\n            tags.className = \"search-result-tags\";\n            tags.textContent = entry.tags.join(\", \");\n            item.appendChild(tags);\n          }\n          list.appendChild(item);\n        });\n      }\n\n      function setup(root, options) {\n        var input = root.querySelector(\".search-input\");\n        var list = root.querySelector(\".search-results\");\n\n        function run() {\n          var term = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();\n          if (!term) {\n            list.hidden = true;\n            return;\n          }\n          var fields = activeFields(root);\n          loadIndex(options.indexUrl).then(function (entries) {\n            var matched = entries.filter(function (entry) {\n              return inScope(entry, options.scope) && matches(entry, term, fields);\n            });\n            renderResults(list, matched, options.siteRoot);\n            list.hidden = false;\n          });\n        }\n\n        input.addEventListener(\"input\", run);\n        root.querySelectorAll(\".search-field\").forEach(function (box) {\n          box.addEventListener(\"change\", run);\n        });\n        document.addEventListener(\"click\", function (event) {\n          if (!root.contains(event.target)) list.hidden = true;\n        });\n      }\n\n      return { setup: setup };\n    })();\n\n    (function () {\n      var header = document.querySelector(\".site-search--header[data-search-root]\");\n      if (header) {\n        window.CGESearch.setup(header, {\n          indexUrl: \"{{ search_index_href }}\",\n          siteRoot: \"{{ site_root }}\",\n          scope: null,\n        });\n      }\n    })();\n  </script>\n  {% endif   <nav class=\"site-nav\">\n        {% for item in nav %}<a href=\"{{ item.href }}\"{% if item.active %} class=\"is-active\"{% endif %}>{{ item.title }}</a>{% endfor %}\n      </nav>\n      {% if search_index_href %}\n      <div class=\"site-search site-search--header\" data-search-root>\n        <form class=\"search-form\" role=\"search\" onsubmit=\"return false;\">\n          <input type=\"search\" class=\"search-input\" placeholder=\"Search the site\" aria-label=\"Search the whole site\">\n          <span class=\"search-fields\">\n            <label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"search-field\" value=\"title\" checked> Title</label>\n            <label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"search-field\" value=\"text\" checked> Text</label>\n            <label><input type=\"checkbox\" class=\"search-field\" value=\"tags\" checked> Tags</label>\n          </span>\n        </form>\n        <ul class=\"search-results\" hidden></ul>\n      </div>\n      {% endif %}\n    </div>\n  </header>\n  {% if search_index_href %}\n  <script>\n    /* Client-side search (#10) against search-index.json — no server-side\n       component. Shared between the sitewide box above (every page,\n       unscoped) and a Continent/Country/Program page's own scoped box\n       (public/page.html, further down the body), so both filter the same\n       fetched index instead of each doing its own request. This script runs\n       before <main>'s content so window.CGESearch exists by the time a\n       scoped box's own inline script (inside the page's content) calls it.\n       Results are built with DOM methods, never innerHTML, because a Post's\n       title and tags are Ambassador-authored text. */\n    window.CGESearch = (function () {\n      var indexPromise = null;\n\n      function loadIndex(url) {\n        if (!indexPromise) {\n          indexPromise = fetch(url)\n            .then(function (response) { return response.json(); })\n            .catch(function () { return []; });\n        }\n        return indexPromise;\n      }\n\n      function activeFields(root) {\n        var fields = [];\n        root.querySelectorAll(\".search-field\").forEach(function (box) {\n          if (box.checked) fields.push(box.value);\n        });\n        return fields;\n      }\n\n      function matches(entry, term, fields) {\n        var haystacks = [];\n        if (fields.indexOf(\"title\") !== -1) haystacks.push(entry.title);\n        if (fields.indexOf(\"text\") !== -1) haystacks.push(entry.text);\n        if (fields.indexOf(\"tags\") !== -1) haystacks.push(entry.tags.join(\" \"));\n        return haystacks.some(function (text) {\n          return (text || \"\").toLowerCase().indexOf(term) !== -1;\n        });\n      }\n\n      function inScope(entry, scope) {\n        if (!scope) return true;\n        return entry.chain.slice(0, scope.length).join(\"/\") === scope.join(\"/\");\n      }\n\n      function renderResults(list, matched, siteRoot) {\n        list.textContent = \"\";\n        if (!matched.length) {\n          var empty = document.createElement(\"li\");\n          empty.className = \"search-empty\";\n          empty.textContent = \"No results.\";\n          list.appendChild(empty);\n          return;\n        }\n        matched.slice(0, 20).forEach(function (entry) {\n          var item = document.createElement(\"li\");\n          item.className = \"search-result\";\n          var link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n          link.href = siteRoot + entry.href;\n          link.textContent = entry.title;\n          item.appendChild(link);\n          if (entry.tags.length) {\n            var tags = document.createElement(\"span\");\n            tags.className = \"search-result-tags\";\n            tags.textContent = entry.tags.join(\", \");\n            item.appendChild(tags);\n          }\n          list.appendChild(item);\n        });\n      }\n\n      function setup(root, options) {\n        var input = root.querySelector(\".search-input\");\n        var list = root.querySelector(\".search-results\");\n\n        function run() {\n          var term = input.value.trim().toLowerCase();\n          if (!term) {\n            list.hidden = true;\n            return;\n          }\n          var fields = activeFields(root);\n          loadIndex(options.indexUrl).then(function (entries) {\n            var matched = entries.filter(function (entry) {\n              return inScope(entry, options.scope) && matches(entry, term, fields);\n            });\n            renderResults(list, matched, options.siteRoot);\n            list.hidden = false;\n          });\n        }\n\n        input.addEventListener(\"input\", run);\n {\n          if (!root.contains(event.target)) list.hidden = true;\n        });\n      }\n\n      return { setup: setup };\n    })();\n\n    (function () {\n      var header = document.querySelector(\".site-search--header[data-search-root]\");\n      if (header) {\n        window.CGESearch.setup(header, {\n          indexUrl: \"{{ search_index_href }}\",\n response.text","originalFile":"\"\"\"T05: Public Posts and cms publish extended.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _topic_section(html: str, topic: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The contents of one Topic's <section>, distinct from a same-named\n    filter <button> (identified by its own \"post-topic-group\" class).\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(\n        rf'<section class=\"post-topic-group\" data-topic=\"{topic}\">(.*?)</section>',\n        html, re.S,\n    )\n    assert match, f\"no post-topic-group section for topic={topic!r}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.publish_page(program.id)\n\n\ndef _create_post(c, program_id: int, title: str, topic: str = \"housing\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello there\",\n              \"topic\": topic, \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef _publish_post(admin_c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=post.status, to_status=\"pending\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={post.program_id}\").text)\n    admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\ndef _program_path(program: models.Page) -> str:\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(a.slug for a in models.list_ancestors(program)[1:]) + f\"/{program.slug}/\"\n\n\n# -- Live preview: grouped by Topic, filterable, drafts hidden --------------\n\n\ndef test_program_page_lists_published_posts_grouped_by_topic(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    housing = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Finding an Apartment\", topic=\"housing\")\n    meals = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Favorite Ramen Shop\", topic=\"meals\")\n    _publish_post(c, housing)\n    _publish_post(c, meals)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    # Each Post sits inside its OWN Topic's <section>, not just anywhere on\n    # the page — a loose \"is the word present\" check wouldn't tell the two\n    # Topics' Posts apart.\n    housing_section = _topic_section(response.text, \"housing\")\n    meals_section = _topic_section(response.text, \"meals\")\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" in housing_section\n    assert \"Finding an Apartment\" not in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" in meals_section\n    assert \"Favorite Ramen Shop\" not in housing_section\n    # Topic filter pills are present, so a visitor can filter to one Topic.\n    assert 'class=\"topic-pill\" data-topic=\"housing\"' in response.text\n    assert 'data-topic=\"all\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_a_public_response(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Still Writing This\")\n    pending = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Submitted For Review\")\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program))\n    assert \"Still Writing This\" not in response.text\n    assert \"Submitted For Review\" not in response.text\n\n    # Not reachable directly by slug either.\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{draft.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n    assert c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{pending.slug}/\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_published_post_renders_sanitized_markdown(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Normal Title\")\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=post.title,\n                        body=\"Hello <script>alert('x')</script> **world**\", topic=post.topic)\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    response = c.get(_program_path(program) + f\"{post.slug}/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<script>\" not in response.text\n    assert \"<strong>world</strong>\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_post_slug_stays_frozen_through_a_title_edit_made_after_publish(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Original Title\")\n    assert post.slug == \"original-title\"\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n\n    models.update_post(post.id, title=\"Renamed After Publish\", body=post.body, topic=post.topic)\n    after = models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n    assert after.title == \"Renamed After Publish\"\n    assert after.slug == \"original-title\"  # frozen\n\n\n# -- cms publish: static export ----------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_writes_published_posts_with_relative_links(client_as, tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_post(c, program.id, \"A Great Week\", topic=\"social-life\")\n    post = _publish_post(c, post)\n    draft = _create_post(c, program.id, \"Not Ready Yet\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    program_dir = out / \"asia\" / \"japan\" / \"kyoto-exchange\"\n    post_html_path = program_dir / post.slug / \"index.html\"\n    assert post_html_path.exists()\n    assert not (program_dir / draft.slug).exists()\n\n    program_html = (program_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'{post.slug}/index.html\"' in program_html  # relative link to the post\n    assert -\n\n\ndef test_plain_text_strips_markdown_markers_without_truncating():\n    body = \"# Heading\\n\\nSome **bold** text with a [link](http://x.test) and more words.\"\n    plain = markdown.plain_text(body)\n    assert \"#\" not in plain and \"**\" not in plain and \"[\" not in plain\n    assert \"Heading\" in plain and \"bold\" in plain and \"link\" in plain\n    assert \"…\" _publish_post(admin_c, admin_c.get(\"/admin\").text, post)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = json.loads((out / \"search-index.json\").read_text())\n\n    assert len(entries) home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n    country = models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n    return models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n\n\ndef _publish_post(c, admin_token_source, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_token_source)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\n# -- app.services.markdown.plain_text: the full-body pipeline excerpt shares -\n\n\ndef test_plain_text_strips_markdown_markers_without_truncating():\n    body = \"# Heading\\n\\nSome **bold** text with a [link](http://x.test) and more words.\"\n    plain = markdown.plain_text(body)\n    assert \"#\" not in plain and \"**\" not in plain and \"[\" not in plain\n    assert \"Heading\" in plain and \"bold\" in plain and \"link\" in plain\n    assert \"…\" not in plain  # plain_text never truncates; excerpt does\n\n\n# -- app.services.search_index.build_index: the pure data shape -------------\n\n\ndef test_index_contains_only_published_posts_with_title_text_and_tags(client_as, tmp_path):\n    visa = models.create_tag(\"visa\")\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    new_page = admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(new_page.text)\n    admin_c.post(\"/admin/posts/new\", data={\n        \"program_id\": str(program.id), \"title\": \"Finding Housing\",\n        \"body\": \"Housing here is **tricky** at first.\", \"topic\": \"housing\",\n        \"tag_ids\": [str(visa.id)], \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token,\n    })\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    _publish_post(admin_c, admin_c.get(\"/admin\").text, post)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = json.loads((out / \"search-index.json\").read_text())\n\n    assert len(entries) == 1\n    entry = entries[0]\n    assert entry[\"title\"] == \"Finding Housing\"\n    assert \"tricky\" in entry[\"text\"]\n    assert \"**\" not in entry[\"text\"]  # markdown stripped, not raw\n    assert entry[\"tags\"] == [\"visa\"]\n    assert entry[\"chain\"] == [\"asia\", \"japan\", \"kyoto-exchange\"]\n    assert entry[\"href\"] == \"asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/finding-housing/index.html\"\n    assert not entry[\"href\"].startswith(\"/\")  # relative, hard constraint\n    assert (out / entry[\"href\"]).exists()\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_the_index(client_as, tmp_path):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"Still A Draft\", \"draft body\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    pending = models.create_post(program.id, \"Awaiting Review\", \"pending body\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    published = models.create_post(program.id, \"Already Live\", \"live body\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    _publish_post(admin_c, admin_c.get(\"/admin\").text, published)\n\n    out = assert draft.status == \"draft\" and pending.status == \"pending\"  # sanity\n\n\ndef test_unpublished_program_contributes_no_entries(client_as, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"A Post can only be published under a published Program (same gate\n    app.publish.render_site itself applies to HTML) — the index must not leak\n    one whose parent Program never went live.\"\"\"\n    admin = country = models.publish_page(models.create_page(continent.id, \"Kenya\", \"\", False, admin.id).id)\n    draft_program = models.create_page(country.id, \"Nairobi Fieldwork\", \"\", False, admin.id)\n    post = models.create_post(draft_program.id, \"Orphaned Post\", \"x\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = json.loads((out / \"search-index.json\").read_text())\n    assert entries == []\n\n\n# -- search boxes in the rendered templates ----------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_sitewide_search_box_is_on_every_public_page(client_as, tmp_path):\n    admin_c =  token = _csrf_token_from(new_page.text)\n    admin_c.post(\"/admin/posts/new\", data={\n        \"program_id\": str(program.id), \"title\": \"A Post\", \"body\": \"x\",\n        \"topic\": )\n    return models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return test_plain_text_strips_markdown_markers_without_truncating():\n    body = \"# Heading\\n\\nSome **bold** text with a [link](http://x.test) and more words.\"\n    plain = markdown.plain_text(body)\n    assert \"#\" not in plain and \"**\" not in plain and \"[\" not in plain\n    assert \"Heading\" in plain and \"bold\" in plain and \"link\" in plain\n    assert \"…\" not in plain  # plain_text never truncates; excerpt does\n\n\n# -- app.services.search_index.build_index: the pure data shape -------------\n\n\ndef test_index_contains_only_published_posts_with_title_text_and_tags(client_as, tmp_path):\n    visa = models.create_tag(\"visa\")\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    new_page = admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(new_page.text)\n    admin_c.post(\"/admin/posts/new\", data={\n        \"program_id\": str(program.id), \"title\": \"Finding Housing\",\n        \"body\": \"Housing here is **tricky** at first.\", \"topic\": \"housing\",\n        \"tag_ids\": [str(visa.id)], \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token,\n    })\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    _publish_post(admin_c, post)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = json.loads((out / \"search-index.json\").read_text())\n\n    assert len(entries) == 1\n    entry = entries[0]\n    assert entry[\"title\"] == \"Finding Housing\"\n    assert \"tricky\" in entry[\"text\"]\n    assert \"**\" not in entry[\"text\"]  # markdown stripped, not raw\n    assert entry[\"tags\"] == [\"visa\"]\n    assert entry[\"chain\"] == [\"asia\", \"japan\", \"kyoto-exchange\"]\n    assert entry[\"href\"] == \"asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/finding-housing/index.html\"\n    assert not entry[\"href\"].startswith(\"/\")  # relative, hard constraint\n    assert (out / entry[\"href\"]).exists()\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_the_index(client_as, tmp_path):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = pending = models.create_post(program.id, \"Awaiting Review\", \"pending body\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    published = models.create_post(program.id, \"Already Live\", \"live body\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    _publish_post(admin_c, published)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = app.publish.render_site itself applies to HTML) — the index must not leak\n    one whose parent Program never went live.\"\"\"\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    home = _csrf_token_from\n\n\ndef _seed_program(author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n    country = models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n    return models.publish_page(\n        models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id).id\n    )\n\n\ndef _admin_csrf(c) -> str:\n    return _csrf_token_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n\n\ndef _publish_post(c, post: models.Post) -> models.Post:\n    token = _admin_csrf(c)\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    return models.get_post_by_id(post.id)\n\n\n# -- app.services.markdown.plain_text: the full-body pipeline excerpt shares -\n\n\ndef test_plain_text_strips_markdown_markers_without_truncating():\n    body = \"# Heading\\n\\nSome **bold** text with a [link](http://x.test) and more words.\"\n    plain = markdown.plain_text(body)\n    assert \"#\" not in plain and \"**\" not in plain and \"[\" not in plain\n    assert \"Heading\" in plain and \"bold\" in plain and \"link\" in plain\n    assert \"…\" not in plain  # plain_text never truncates; excerpt does\n\n\n# -- app.services.search_index.build_index: the pure data shape -------------\n\n\ndef test_index_contains_only_published_posts_with_title_text_and_tags(client_as, tmp_path):\n    visa = models.create_tag(\"visa\")\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    new_page = admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(new_page.text)\n    admin_c.post(\"/admin/posts/new\", data={\n        \"program_id\": str(program.id), \"title\": \"Finding Housing\",\n        \"body\": \"Housing here is **tricky** at first.\", \"topic\": \"housing\",\n        \"tag_ids\": [str(visa.id)], \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token,\n    })\n    post = models.list_posts_by_program(program.id)[0]\n    _publish_post(admin_c, post)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = json.loads((out / \"search-index.json\").read_text())\n\n    assert len(entries) == 1\n    entry = entries[0]\n    assert entry[\"title\"] == \"Finding Housing\"\n    assert \"tricky\" in entry[\"text\"]\n    assert \"**\" not in entry[\"text\"]  # markdown stripped, not raw\n    assert entry[\"tags\"] == [\"visa\"]\n    assert entry[\"chain\"] == [\"asia\", \"japan\", \"kyoto-exchange\"]\n    assert entry[\"href\"] == \"asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/finding-housing/index.html\"\n    assert not entry[\"href\"].startswith(\"/\")  # relative, hard constraint\n    assert (out / entry[\"href\"]).exists()\n\n\ndef test_draft_and_pending_posts_never_reach_the_index(client_as, models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    published = models.create_post(program.id, \"Already Live\", \"live body\", \"general\", admin.id)\n    _publish_post(admin_c, published)\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    entries = json.loads((out / \"search-index.json\").read_text())\n    titles = {e[\"title\"] for e in entries}\n\n    assert titles == {\"Already Live\"}\n    assert draft.status == \"draft\" and pending.status == \"pending\"  # sanity\n\n\ndef test_unpublished_program_contributes_no_entries(client_as, tmp_path):\n {"parentUuid":"8d9d9ac0-a687-4527-ae8f-aa02fa39fc67","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"de76ca71-a717-4a52-b238-6e620e2b35de","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01THd4NvnMjzin3RqcCQgvPT","type":"tool_result","content":"14 entries\n{'title': 'The 600-yen lunch that fixed my budget', 'text': 'My food budget was a disaster for the first fortnight. I was eating dinner out most nights because cooking in a shared kitchen felt like an imposition, and the yen adds up fast when every meal is a decision. Then one of the second-years took me to a teishoku place near the university gate: a set lunch, one price, rice and soup refilled without asking. It is six hundred yen and it is the single best thing that has happened to my spending. How I eat now Set lunch on weekdays, cook properly twice a week, and save going out for the weekend, when there is someone to go with. That rhythm has cut my food spending by something like a third. Nobody tells you that the cheapest meal of the day here is also the best one. The other lesson: the places with plastic food in the window and no English menu have been consistently kinder about my terrible Japanese than the ones that cater to visitors.', 'tags': ['budget'], 'chain': ['asia', 'japan', 'kyoto-exchange'], 'href': 'asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/the-600-yen-lunch-that-fixed-my-budget/index.html'}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"b00ff9f6-959c-4e86-a68c-bf1a84fde7b2","timestamp":"2026-10-07T02:30:32.731Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"14 entries\n{'title': 'The 600-yen lunch that fixed my budget', 'text': 'My food budget was a disaster for the first fortnight. {"parentUuid":"7e357372-1017-46a8-bb90-463110415b33","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfn6DXktjTBvBTKttT6jX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NaJRaHbVoHdEZWDNrS7bx3","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/tmp/claude-1000/-home-adam-leider-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f/scratchpad/check_search.py","content":"from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nBASE = \"http://127.0.0.1:8123\"\n\nwith sync_playwright() as p:\n    browser = p.chromium.launch()\n\n    for width, label in [(390, \"mobile\"), (1280, \"desktop\")]:\n        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 900})\n        page = ctx.new_page()\n        errors = []\n        page.on(\"pageerror\", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))\n        page.on(\"console\", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == \"error\" else None)\n\n        # Home page: sitewide header search.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        page.fill(\".site-search--header .search-input\", \"budget\")\n        page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n        results = page.locator(\".site-search--header .search-results .search-result\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] home header search 'budget' -> {results.count()} result(s)\")\n        scroll_w = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\")\n        client_w = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] home scrollWidth={scroll_w} clientWidth={client_w} (overflow={'YES' if scroll_w > client_w else 'no'})\")\n        page.screenshot(path=f\"/tmp/cms-search-demo/home-{width}.png\", full_page=True)\n\n        # Program page: scoped search.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        assert page.locator(\".site-search--scoped\").count() == 1\n        page.fill(\".site-search--scoped .search-input\", \"budget\")\n        page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n        scoped_results = page.locator(\".site-search--scoped .search-results .search-result\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] program scoped search 'budget' -> {scoped_results.count()} result(s)\")\n        scroll_w2 = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\")\n        client_w2 = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] program scrollWidth={scroll_w2} clientWidth={client_w2} (overflow={'YES' if scroll_w2 > client_w2 else 'no'})\")\n        page.screenshot(path=f\"/tmp/cms-search-demo/program-{width}.png\", full_page=True)\n\n        # Continent page: scope should exclude results outside Asia.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/africa/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        page.fill(\".site-search--scoped .search-input\", \"budget\")\n        page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n        africa_results = page.locator(\".site-search--scoped .search-results .search-result\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] africa scoped search 'budget' (should be scoped away from Asia posts) -> {africa_results.count()} result(s)\")\n\n        # Home page should have NO scoped box.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] home has scoped box: {page.locator('.site-search--scoped').count() == 1}\")\n\n        print(f\"[{label}] console/page errors: {errors}\")\n        ctx.close()\n\n    browser.close()\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":742,"cache_read_input_tokens":195654,"output_tokens":1292,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":742,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1292,"cache_read_input_tokens":195654,"cache_creation_input_tokens":742,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":742},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01NaJRaHbVoHdEZWDNrS7bx3":{"file_path":"/tmp/claude-1000/-home-adam-leider-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f/scratchpad/check_search.py","content":"from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nBASE = \"http://127.0.0.1:8123\"\n\nwith sync_playwright() as p:\n    browser = p.chromium.launch()\n\n    for width, label in [(390, \"mobile\"), (1280, \"desktop\")]:\n        ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": 900})\n        page = ctx.new_page()\n        errors = []\n        page.on(\"pageerror\", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))\n        page.on(\"console\", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == \"error\" else None)\n\n        # Home page: sitewide header search.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        page.fill(\".site-search--header .search-input\", \"budget\")\n        page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n        results = page.locator(\".site-search--header .search-results .search-result\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] home header search 'budget' -> {results.count()} result(s)\")\n        scroll_w = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\")\n        client_w = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] home scrollWidth={scroll_w} clientWidth={client_w} (overflow={'YES' if scroll_w > client_w else 'no'})\")\n        page.screenshot(path=f\"/tmp/cms-search-demo/home-{width}.png\", full_page=True)\n\n        # Program page: scoped search.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        assert page.locator(\".site-search--scoped\").count() == 1\n        page.fill(\".site-search--scoped .search-input\", \"budget\")\n        page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n        scoped_results = page.locator(\".site-search--scoped .search-results .search-result\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] program scoped search 'budget' -> {scoped_results.count()} result(s)\")\n        scroll_w2 = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\")\n        client_w2 = page.evaluate(\"document.documentElement.clientWidth\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] program scrollWidth={scroll_w2} clientWidth={client_w2} (overflow={'YES' if scroll_w2 > client_w2 else 'no'})\")\n        page.screenshot(path=f\"/tmp/cms-search-demo/program-{width}.png\", full_page=True)\n\n        # Continent page: scope should exclude results outside Asia.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/africa/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        page.fill(\".site-search--scoped .search-input\", \"budget\")\n        page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n        africa_results = page.locator(\".site-search--scoped .search-results .search-result\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] africa scoped search 'budget' (should be scoped away from Asia posts) -> {africa_results.count()} result(s)\")\n\n        # Home page should have NO scoped box.\n        page.goto(BASE + \"/\", wait_until=\"networkidle\")\n        print(f\"[{label}] home has scoped box: {page.locator('.site-search--scoped').count() == 1}\")\n\n        print(f\"[{label}] console/page errors: {errors}\")\n        ctx.close()\n\n    browser.close()\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3087893c-2fc5-4819-ac8c-0b5793c78710","session_id":"882a2889-8e73-41e6-892c-8e61768cfd6d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"d1abca07-89ec-401e-ae66-6c7405c1f31f","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"feature/site-search"}

{"parentUuid":"f2a821cd-4884-4aa8-b2bf-b6c0860a535a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cfn6JaUExbgnScg2eaXeM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Uzg753pV4HpuUKDiGCxLWn","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"gh pr create --title \"T09: Site search (#10)\" --base main --head feature/site-search --body \"$(cat <<'EOF'\n## Summary\n\n- Adds a client-side search index: `cms publish` writes `search-index.json` alongside `site/`'s HTML, containing only published Posts (title, body text, tags, and the slug chain of the Program they live under). The live admin preview serves the same shape from the database at `/search-index.json`, so search works before anyone publishes.\n- Adds a sitewide search box to the public header (every page) and a scoped search box on Continent/Country/Program pages (filtered to that page's own subtree via the Program slug chain).\n- Each search box has independent Title/Text/Tags checkboxes; matching and rendering happen entirely in the browser (`window.CGESearch`, vanilla JS, no server-side search component). Purely a duplication nit; behavior is correct in all three.\n2. `app/routes/public.py:63` — `is_continent_page(page)` is computed inline for `search_scope_chain` rather than assigned to a local like the adjacent `is_country`/`is_program`, inconsistent style with the mirrored block in `publish.py` which does name all three.\n3. Acceptance criterion \"every search box works at 390px with no horizontal scroll\" (issue #10) has no automated check — consistent with this repo's existing practice of verifying phone-width via manual Playwright screenshots (`scripts/screenshot.py`) rather than pytest, so not a regression introduced by this PR, but it also wasn't manually re-verified for the two new search boxes. CSS (`search-input`/`site-search` width rules under the `max-width: 48rem` query) looks structurally sound but unconfirmed live.\n4. No automated test exercises the actual client-side filter logic (`matches`/`inScope`/field checkboxes) — again consistent with the project having zero JS unit tests today, just worth flagging since it's the one acceptance-criterion behavior (checkbox-scoped matching) that's only verified by inspection, not test.\n\n**Correctness checks performed, no bugs found:**\n- Closures: the two new `href_for` lambdas passed to `search_index.build_index` execute eagerly and synchronously inside `build_index`, before/outside the `for page in all_pages` render loop — they don't capture `page`/`chain` from that loop, so the known stale-closure pattern in `post_groups` lambdas does not recur here.\n- `site_root` / relative-path math: verified `_relative_link`'s `\"../\" * len(chain)` against `search-index.json`'s root-relative `href` values (e.g. `asia/japan/kyoto-exchange/finding-housing/index.html`) — `siteRoot + entry.href` correctly resolves from every depth, confirmed by `tests/test_t09.py`'s own nested-path assertions and direct inspection.\n- Script ordering: `base.html`'s `window.CGESearch` definition sits before `&lt;main&gt;`, so `page.html`'s scoped-box inline script (inside `&lt;main&gt;`/`{% block content %}`) always runs after it — correct per HTML parse order.\n- Template variable plumbing: both `publish.py` render call sites (page and post) and both `public.py` context builders (`page_context`, `post_context`) correctly supply `site_root`/`search_index_href`/`search_scope_chain` (or omit scope where N/A) — no name mismatch between the two renderers.\n- Live-preview route uses root-absolute hrefs (`\"/...\"`) by design, matching the pre-existing `_path_for` convention already used elsewhere in `public.py` for nav/breadcrumbs; this is the local-only admin console (never deployed), so it doesn't violate the published-site relative-path constraint, and the static `cms publish` path is fully relative as required.\n- Draft/pending/unpublished-Program exclusion verified both by reading `list_published_posts_by_program`/`is_program_page` gating in `search_index.build_index` and by the three dedicated tests in `test_t09.py`.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>77340</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>25</tool_uses><duration_ms>289011</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}
